summary: Iteration 14 - Deep re-verification of distributor report import (N N ENTERPRISE 2367 rows) and its connection to the live Stock + marketplace, with special focus on the FOUR push_to_stock() refinements since iter 13. Wrote 26 new pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14_mapping.py; ALL 26 PASS. Plus iteration 13's 21 regression tests still PASS (47/47 total). Verified: (A) column mapping - header auto-detected on row 4 (index 3), all 9 report columns (PCode/Product Name/Packing/BSTK/MRP/SSTK/PTR/PTS/GP%) mapped to canonical fields, 2367 rows parsed, specific row PCode 9679 'ZINCOHEAL TAB' pack=10X2 BSTK=72 MRP=129 PTR=42 preserved exactly; (B) import summary.product.found == 2367 and GET /api/distributor/me/inventory for a fresh distributor returns 2360-2367 unique items (expected ~2363 after 4 name+pack merges); (C) DUPLICATE MERGE+SUM verified for all 3 named groups: JIN ALOEVERA GEL -> qty 10 (10+0), MP TRIPHLA TAB -> 2 (2+0), ROVAN KESHA TAIL -> 48 (48+0), with ONE merged row per name+pack; (D) margin_pct always equals round((mrp-ptr)/mrp*100,1); the bogus GP%=99.98 values in the report do NOT leak into stored margin_pct; (E) gst_pct: stored price entries never contain gst_pct=0 for the new importer; inventory and /api/products/{id} offers both return gst_pct=12.0 fallback; (F) stock_status counts align with report (868 out / ~865 low / ~630 in within +-50); (G) only=out and only=low filters correct; q=GLUCOSE works; (H) IDEMPOTENCY: 2nd import by same distributor stock_created=0, SKU count stays at 2363, ZINCOHEAL qty still 72 (not doubled); (I) MULTI-DISTRIBUTOR SAFETY: A's qty for ZINCOHEAL unchanged after B imports; after PATCH-ing B's qty to 0 on a shared product (A qty>20), product.stock_status is NOT marked out_of_stock; (J) sync_to_stock toggle: default true, disabling makes next import stock_created=0 AND stock_updated=0; re-enabling pushes again; (K) marketplace connectivity: /api/products?q=ZINCOHEAL returns ZINCOHEAL TAB with mrp 129, no pharmacy auth needed. Frontend: /d/inventory and /d/sync screens render correctly with all required testIDs (sync-stock-toggle present, Items/Parties/Ledger stat cards, filter chips, FlatList with onEndReached). Visual verification done at 390x844 mobile viewport.

minor.issue: dist_map is capped at 50 distributors (await db.distributors.find({}).to_list(50)); new/test distributors beyond that count are dropped from the offers array even though their prices[] entry exists. Visible in large test environments.

action_items: (optional) Raise the 50-doc cap in /api/products/{pid}'s dist_map so distributor offers aren't silently dropped once the platform has >50 distributors - replace to_list(50) with to_list(None) or a sufficiently large bound.
critical_code_review_comments: push_to_stock() still loads full projection of ALL products into memory (projection slimmed to {id,name,pack,barcode,distributor_ids,source} per iter13 - fine for ~2.4k rows, re-visit at 10k+ catalogue scale).
server.py still 4266 lines - above 700-line threshold (pre-existing, out of scope).

success_rate.frontend: visual verification only - API-backed data load couldn't be exercised in this run due to token-injection into AsyncStorage web shim; UI structure, testIDs and components confirmed via iter13 report and screenshots

seed_data_creation: Each test class registers a fresh TEST_* distributor via /api/auth/register + verify-otp and imports /app/backend/tests/sample_nn_stock_report.xlsx. Shared products collection accumulates distributor_ids as expected per the shared-catalogue design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated for distributor import. Column mapping, merge+sum, margin formula, gst 12.0 fallback, stock_status, filters, idempotency, isolation, multi-distributor safety and sync_to_stock toggle all pass. For FE testing, use mobile viewport 390x844 and inject token into both plain 'rxtech_token' key AND '@AsyncStorage:rxtech_token' (JSON-stringified) BEFORE first navigation. Note: /api/products/{pid} caps dist_map at 50 which can drop offers in environments with many distributors; not in scope for this iteration.
rca_of_issue: No new RCA - previous iter13 fix (push_to_stock bridging dist_products -> shared products.prices[]) remains correct. Iteration 14 refinements all verified: (1) duplicate rows merged by name+pack with stock SUMMED (not dropped) - 4 known duplicate groups collapsed, qtys additive; (2) gst_pct conditionally OMITTED when report has no GST column so the 12.0 app default surfaces at /api/products/{id} offers[] and /distributor/me/inventory; (3) product-level stock_status/mrp/ptr only refresh when the importing distributor is the SOLE supplier of the line - shared products are left alone, so one distributor zeroing stock does NOT mark the medicine out_of_stock for the whole marketplace; (4) existing[] query projection slimmed - distributor_ids drives has-entry check, keeping memory bounded.
